enterprise.name: Beef Feedlot Enterprise
enterprise.description: DRAFT - a beef feedlot enterprise: enteric fermentation and manure emissions from the penned herd, plus the farm's energy, waste and upstream (Scope 3) emissions. No Fertiliser or Agricultural Residue module - feedlot cattle are penned/fed, not grazing pasture, and neither row appears in the VEERG Chapter 2 Module Map for beef feedlot. Not yet ready for build-enterprise - the templateWorkbook does not exist yet and must be hand-authored (see enterprise-template-authoring.md).

modules.comment: IMPORT-ORDER RULE: the CANONICAL module for a shared input sheet must be listed FIRST. ManureManagement_Feedlot and Enteric_Feedlot both ship 'Input - Feedlot'; ManureManagement is canonical here - confirmed via named-range count (20 X_Cell_/X_Table_ names in 4_1_ManureManagement_Feedlot_WIP_v08.xlsx vs only 3 in 3_1_Enteric_Feedlot_WIP_v02.xlsx, same signal used to pick the canonical module for Swine/Dairy/BeefPasture). KNOWN BUILD BLOCKER: this module's groups include 'Livestock', which pulls in a sheet named 'Constants - Common Livestock' via the registry's sheetGroups.Livestock - but 4_1_ManureManagement_Feedlot_WIP_v08.xlsx currently names that sheet 'Constants - Livestock' (confirmed 2026-08), the same mismatch Swine and Poultry hit. Rename that sheet to 'Constants - Common Livestock' in the source workbook BEFORE running build-enterprise, or the build will fail with "'Constants - Common Livestock' (category constants) not found".

Duplicate of the shared input sheet: 'input' is left out of include so it defaults to the registry's full 'Input - Feedlot' list, but dedupeSheetsByName + onDuplicateSheet=skip silently drops it in favour of the canonical copy already imported by ManureManagement_Feedlot above - same pattern as Enterprise_Swine.json.

Fertiliser constants required for manure sent off site calcs (same dependency as Enterprise_Swine.json and Enterprise_Poultry.json) - NOT the full Fertiliser module, since Fertiliser Use does not appear in the beef feedlot Module Map table at all (penned cattle, no pasture fertiliser application).

Per the Chapter 2 doc's Beef Feedlot MODULE MAP TABLE (authoritative - not the prose 'additional guidance' sentence): relevant Scope 3 rows are 15.1 Purchased Livestock, 15.2 Purchased Feed, 15.3 Purchased Mineral Supplements, 15.7 Purchased Services/Contractors, 15.10 Other Purchased Goods and Services, 15.11 Upstream Emission from Fuel, 15.12 Upstream Emissions of Purchased Electricity, 15.13 Management of Waste. Unlike Swine/Poultry, Feedlot's table DOES list 15.3 Purchased Mineral Supplements - keep that row when picking results from '15 Scope 3'. The '15 Scope 3' calc sheet carries all Scope3 sub-sections with no per-row subsetting available, so irrelevant rows (15.4 fertiliser components, 15.5 agrichemicals, 15.6 lime, 15.8 packaging, 15.9 grow media, 15.14 freight - NOT in the feedlot table) will still show up when listing/pasting results; pick only the relevant rows by hand. OPEN QUESTION (same as Swine/Poultry): 'Input - Freight' is kept below since freight-adjacent quantities may still feed other included rows, but the table does not list a distinct Freight module (15.14) for beef feedlot the way it does for Dairy/PastureBeef - worth confirming whether it's actually needed before building.

menu.comment: The column-A navigation menu is regenerated on every sheet from the final sheet set. Groups are assigned automatically: Home/Results = untitled; any sheet named 'Input*' = INPUTS; calculation sheets = CALCULATIONS; everything else = APPENDICES. 'labels' overrides the link text for a sheet (default derivation strips the 'Input - ' prefix, otherwise uses the sheet name). Set enabled=false to leave existing menus untouched.
